events.name: Delaware Blue Hens at Western Kentucky Hilltoppers

headlines.description: — Nick Minicucci threw for 414 yards and four touchdowns, with 183 yards and two scores going to Sean Wilson, and Delaware beat Western Kentucky 35-21 on Tuesday night to snap a seven-game road losing streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nick Minicucci throws for 414 yards and 4 TDs as Delaware beats Western Kentucky 35-21
